transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I feel like once I start eating at night after work, I can’t stop or control how much I’m eating. It's really starting to worry me, and I realized I need some help to figure out why this is happening.
Do you also have episodes of eating large amounts of food during the day, or is this loss of control mainly happening at night after work?

It mainly happens at night after I get home from the office. During the day, I'm completely focused on my busy job, but once I finally get home late and sit down in front of my laptop, that's when the loss of control kicks in.
After these nighttime eating episodes, do you ever try to make up for it by vomiting, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do any of those things to make up for it. Instead, I just sit there surrounded by the empty containers, feeling completely disgusted and ashamed of myself. I usually just end up scrolling through my work emails or Instagram to try and distract myself from what I've done.
Do you ever have episodes of eating a large amount of food with a loss of control during the day as well, or is it only at night after work?
No, it never happens during the day because I'm too busy and focused on my work. It strictly happens in the evening once I'm back in my apartment after a long, stressful day.
Do you usually wake up during the night to eat, or is the eating only happening after dinner while you are still awake?

No, I don't wake up in the middle of the night to eat. It all happens while I'm still awake, starting as soon as I get home late from work and continuing while I'm on my laptop. I just end up staying up really late doing this before I finally go to bed.

Do you usually eat most of your food after dinner or at night, and do you ever wake up from sleep to eat? Or are these episodes more like sudden binges where you eat a very large amount in a short time while awake?

No, I never wake up from sleep to eat; it always happens while I'm fully awake right after I get home. These are definitely sudden, out-of-control binges where I shovel down a massive amount of takeout food incredibly fast while sitting in front of my laptop.
Do you feel your eating is mainly concentrated in the evening and at night, with very little appetite or food intake earlier in the day? Also, has this pattern been going on for at least 3 months?

Yes, it is definitely concentrated in the evenings, and this pattern has been going on for about three months now since my big work campaign started. I'm not really sure about my daytime appetite, but my main issue is definitely the out-of-control binging at night rather than how I eat during the day.

Do you usually eat very little in the morning and afternoon, with most of your food intake happening in the evening or at night? This helps me tell whether this is mainly a night-eating pattern or a binge-eating pattern.

Honestly, I haven't paid close attention to my daytime eating habits, so I'm not entirely sure if I'm eating too little then. The main issue for me is the overwhelming loss of control and the massive amount of food I consume once I get home at night.
Do you usually eat very little or skip meals earlier in the day, with most of your food intake happening in the evening or at night?

I don't think I necessarily skip meals or restrict myself during the day, as I usually eat normally when I have a moment at work. It's just that the out-of-control, binge-like eating consistently and specifically happens at night once I finally get home.
Do you ever find yourself eating after you have already gone to bed or waking up during the night to eat, or does all of the eating happen while you are still awake in the evening?

No, I never wake up from sleep to eat, and I don't eat after I've already gone to bed. All of the eating happens while I'm still awake in the evening, usually right after I get home from work and while I'm sitting in front of my laptop.
When these episodes happen at night, do you feel a strong urge to eat after waking from sleep or after already falling asleep, or do they only happen while you are fully awake in the evening?
They only happen while I am fully awake in the evening. It always starts right after I get home from a long day at work while I'm sitting in front of my laptop, rather than waking up from sleep.
About how much of your total food intake do you think happens after dinner or in the evening, compared with earlier in the day? For example, is more than half of what you eat usually at night?

I'm not entirely sure about the exact percentage or how it compares to my daytime eating because I don't really track what I eat during the day. But I do know that the amount I eat at night feels incredibly large and completely out of my control.
Do you also spend a lot of time worrying about your weight or body shape, or use any behaviors like dieting, skipping meals, vomiting, laxatives, or excessive exercise to control your weight?

No, I don't engage in any of those behaviors like vomiting, using laxatives, or extreme dieting. I haven't really been focusing on my weight in that way either; my main struggle is just the out-of-control eating itself.
Have you been intentionally trying to lose weight or strongly worried about your weight or body shape, even if you are not purging or exercising excessively?

No, I haven't really been trying to lose weight or focusing specifically on my body shape. I am mostly just overwhelmed and deeply ashamed by the out-of-control eating episodes themselves. The complete lack of control is what is really distressing to me.

On a typical day, do you eat most of your food in the evening or at night, with very little earlier in the day? Or are your eating episodes mainly sudden binges at night without most of your total intake being shifted to that time?

I'm not entirely sure about the exact balance of my food intake during the day versus the night. But these nighttime episodes definitely feel like sudden, distinct, and completely out-of-control binges rather than just a gradual shift in my daily eating schedule.

When you are not having these episodes, do you usually eat most of your food in the evening or at night, with very little earlier in the day? Or are these mainly separate binge episodes that happen at night while your overall eating is otherwise spread through the day?

I'm not entirely sure because I haven't paid close attention to my daytime eating patterns on other days. What I do know is that these are definitely distinct, out-of-control binge episodes that happen specifically on those late nights after work.
